The evidence supports the claim that scanned PDFs can weaken citation quality through multiple documented mechanisms:

1. **Citation mapping failures**: For scanned, image-only PDFs, citation mapping "either points to page one of a 200-page document or doesn't generate a citation link at all" [NL-018#NL-018-S04]. For example, a query about the code blue checklist returned a citation to page one of a 150-page document instead of page 87 [NL-018#NL-018-S04].

2. **No text offsets prevent citations**: Scanned PDFs cause TutorChat to "either return an answer with no source citations because it can't find text offsets, or the citation points to the entire document – like page 1 of a 250-page PDF – rather than a specific section", which "directly violates our reliability guidelines" [NL-021#NL-021-S02].

3. **Remaining citation tickets are tied to scanned PDFs**: Although the April fix reduced citation tickets overall, the remaining tickets in May and June "are almost entirely linked to scanned, image-only PDFs", where TutorChat "struggles to establish citation anchors, often linking back to the start of the file rather than the specific page" [NL-011#NL-011-S05].

4. **OCR is heuristic and can corrupt output**: Without OCR, scanned PDFs cannot generate citations because the parser extracts zero text. Even with OCR, blurry or complex layouts can produce misread characters or broken paragraphs, directly causing "Broken Citations" where TutorChat may not link to the exact paragraph [NL-006#NL-006-S03].

5. **Low-resolution scans affect page/section identification**: If the answer comes from a "low-resolution scanned PDF", the layout parser "could not determine the exact page or section ID", resulting in "No citation available" or broken link icons [NL-006#NL-006-S04].

6. **System UI flags the risk**: A proposed upload warning states: "Ingesting this file without OCR may result in poor citation quality", and scanned PDFs are flagged with reduced citation confidence (e.g., 45%) [NL-021#NL-021-S05].

7. **General documentation confirms the limitation**: "If you ask a question based on scanned PDFs of low quality, the system may struggle to generate page-specific citations due to OCR limitations" [NL-028#NL-028-S03].
